page_title: SAS 1-1 PAR | Sassuolo v Parma 03/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Ermano Feliciani is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Sassuolo) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
90+2' The free kick into the penalty area from Nahuel Estevez (Parma) is cleared.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' Ismael Kone (Sassuolo) blasts the ball high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.
89' Alessandro Circati (Parma) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Ermano Feliciani ignores the protests.
89' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
86' Here is a change. Josh Doig is going off and Fabio Grosso gives the last tactical orders to Fali Cande (Sassuolo).
85' Nicholas Pierini (Sassuolo) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Armand Lauriente.
85' Here's the change. Andrea Pinamonti leaves the pitch and Luca Moro (Sassuolo) comes on as a substitute.
82' A cross from Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
80' Parma force their opponents to concede a corner.

79' Pontus Almqvist (Parma) leaps high near the penalty spot and gets a header in from the free kick. It's on target, but the goalkeeper dives to his right to save the attempt which was aimed towards the underside of the crossbar. It was a difficult header and it's always tough to put the ball inside the net from positions like that. Parma force their opponents to concede a corner.
78' Substitution. Enrico Del Prato makes way for Sascha Britschgi (Parma).
77' Walid Cheddira (Sassuolo) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.
75' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
75' Walid Cheddira (Sassuolo) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
74' We are about to witness a subsitution. Walid Cheddira (Sassuolo) for Alieu Fadera.

72' Pontus Almqvist (Parma) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Arijanet Muric inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball low into the middle of the target, but was denied by a great save.
71' Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
70' Carlos Cuesta decides to make a substitution. Gaetano Oristanio will be replaced by Pontus Almqvist (Parma).
70' We are about to witness a substitution. Nahuel Estevez (Parma) is replacing Jacob Ondrejka.
69' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
68' Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Sassuolo have a corner.
64' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) climbs high to connect with a cross on the edge of the box, but his header is off-target. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.
62' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
59' That will be all from Luca Lipani who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Ismael Kone (Sassuolo).
59' The foul by Nemanja Matic (Sassuolo) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Ermano Feliciani.
58' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) makes a run into the box and gets on the end of a cross, but his well-taken shot crashes into a defender and is cleared away.
56' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Sebastian Walukiewicz (Sassuolo) but poses no threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
54' Gaetano Oristanio (Parma) creates space for himself in the box and shoots, but the effort is unwittingly blocked by one of his own teammates.
53' The ball is cleared after Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
51' The foul by Josh Doig (Sassuolo) was seen by Ermano Feliciani who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
49' Josh Doig (Sassuolo) misses a great chance to score after his effort hits the left post! The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.
48' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

48' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) is the one to unleash a good effort towards the bottom right corner. His shot, however, is saved by the goalkeeper. What a save! Parma will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
47' A weak shot from the edge of the box by Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) is easily saved by Arijanet Muric.
46' Referee Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle. Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) commits a foul after dangerous play.
42' Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Arijanet Muric has no trouble gathering it.
41' Enrico Del Prato (Parma) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The ball goes out of play and Parma have been awarded a corner kick.
40' A cross from a corner kick by Sassuolo is too strong and the ball goes well out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.

39' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) tries his luck from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort, but it is well blocked by the defender. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Sassuolo.
38' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
35' Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
33' Ermano Feliciani has a clear sight and sees a foul from Mandela Keita (Parma).
31' Enrico Del Prato (Parma) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
27' A pass from Josh Doig (Sassuolo) is intercepted by Edoardo Corvi and the move breaks down.
24' 1 - 1 Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) strikes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box and it goes straight inside the left post!
21' Lautaro Valenti (Parma) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
19' Josh Doig (Sassuolo) was too forceful with his tackle and Ermano Feliciani interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
18' What an amazing save by Edoardo Corvi! Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot towards the bottom left corner, but fails.
16' The corner is swung in but Sassuolo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
14' The ball goes out of play. Sassuolo are awarded a corner kick.
14' Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.

12' 1 - 0 Sebastian Walukiewicz produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) rises high to head the ball into the bottom left corner and beyond the goalkeeper. He makes it 1:0.
10' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that's well off target and flies miles wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo will have a goal kick.
8' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
7' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
6' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
5' Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
3' Nemanja Matic (Sassuolo) makes a rough challenge and Ermano Feliciani blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The match has just started.
